The company also says its products serve 2.5 million businesses, according to a mid-August 2026 usage snapshot. The milestone does not mean every organization has an effective AI strategy. It does mean familiarity with AI copilots is increasingly widespread among employees, customers, and prospective buyers. articles.title: Build a Local Automation Enviroment: Self-Hosted n8n + Node.js API with Docker Compose 🐳
articles.summary: When it comes to workflow automation, n8n is one of the most powerful open-source tools avalible. However, relying exclusively on third-party APIs or cloud instances can introduce latency, strict rate limits, and data privacy concerns. The solution? A self-hosted, cloud-native architecture. In this tutorial, I will Show you how to spin up a local development environment that orchestrates an n8n container and a custom Node.js REST API, communicating securely through an internal Docker bridge network. The Architecture Instead of exposing aour database or API to the public internet for n8n to consume, we will encapsulate both services within a Docker bridge network. This provides two main benefits: Security: Services can communicate with each other internally, but you maintain full control over which ports are exposed to the host machine. articles.title: Challenges of Digital Transformation in the Philippine Public Sector 🇵🇭
articles.summary: Working in IT in the public sector has taught me that digital transformation is not just about introducing new systems or technologies. One of the biggest challenges is working with existing processes that were designed long before digital tools became part of everyday operations. Sometimes, even if a better system is available, policies, procurement processes, limited resources, infrastructure, and resistance to change can slow down implementation. Another challenge is systems integration. Different offices may use different platforms, databases, or even separate spreadsheets, which makes sharing information and getting a complete picture difficult. There is also the challenge of balancing innovation with security, data privacy, compliance, and accountability. In government, technology needs to work not only technically, but also within existing rules and responsibilities. And probably one of the most important challenges is adoption.
